race.description: NZB Alf Kneebone Trans-Tasman Trophy Hcp (Bm88)
race.comment: AGENT ZERO (3) had no luck first-up at the Kensington track then the blinkers went on and he overcame adversity to score over 1500m at Randwick last start. Steps up in grade but drops 3kgs and this longer trip suits. Great chance to go back-to-back. ROCK EMPIRE (1) did a good job last time out when fresh from a 31-day let-up, beating all but the very handy Man Of Worth over 1500m at Randwick. Did it tough that day so the effort was full of merit. Untried at this distance but from a good gate should enjoy a cozy run. SUPER HELPFUL (8) is finding the line well and needs this sort of trip now. FORTUNE (2) the best of the rest.
